offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures specialized equipment for roadway maintenance, vegetation management, agriculture and construction. It sells to municipalities, contractors and farmers through dealers and direct accounts, and builds most products in its own plants.

primary_products.value: street sweepers; vacuum trucks; mowers and rotary cutters; excavator attachments; agricultural tillage and harvesting equipment

customer_segment.value: B2B: contractors, rental companies, commercial landscapers, farmers; B2G: municipalities, state and county road departments

end_markets.value: infrastructure maintenance; agriculture; construction; municipal services; forestry

revenue_model.value: product sales: new equipment sold to municipal, contractor and farm customers; other: replacement parts and aftermarket components for installed equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds equipment from purchased components, sold through dealers and direct to municipalities and farms; brand owner: designs and markets several equipment brands made in its own plants

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: industrial equipment (sweepers, vacuum trucks, mowers, attachments) and agricultural equipment (mowers, tillage, harvesting)

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent equipment dealers in North America and abroad; direct sales: direct sales to municipalities and large national accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety, emissions and road-vehicle standards for sweepers and vacuum trucks
